description: Emergenza alluvione 2023 maggio - rilievo con DRONI is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Agenzia per l'Italia Digitale. Orthophotos created by CNR-IGAG, CNR-IRPI, ISPRA, JRC, UNIFI and coordinated by the Department of Civil Protection, through the use of drones, on areas affected by landslides following the adverse weather event of 2-4 and 16-17 May 2023. Coverage: IT. The listing shows 2023-08-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
